observation.command: echo "=== wms workspace services ==="; ls /opt/deegree/xplan-services-wms-workspace/services/; echo "=== service name/url ==="; grep -rn "name=\|url=\|<Service" /opt/deegree/xplan-services-wms-workspace/services/*.xml 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "name|url" | head; echo; echo "=== check the wms service file ==="; for f in /opt/deegree/xplan-services-wms-workspace/services/*.xml; do echo "--- $f ---"; grep -iE "name|url" "$f" | head -5; done
